text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Everything is rooted in my daily training.
The
lessons you've taught live within me
and emerge
naturally when I run.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thus, while my soul is ablaze with the
fire of
determination, my heart remains
as fluid as
flowing water.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes! My path is clear—here I come!
choice_data_list: 学んだ全てを見せてこい！
学んだ全てを見せてきて！
